description: An agent-based model to simulate the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks, incorporating social influence and government intervention.

behaviors.name: decide_to_wear_mask
behaviors.description: Determines if a person decides to wear a mask based on social influence, risk perception, and received information.
behaviors.algorithm: If social_influence > influence_threshold or risk_perception high or received_info is true, set mask_wearing_status to true.

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Influences connected individuals to consider wearing masks based on personal mask-wearing status.
behaviors.algorithm: Spread influence to network connections, increasing their social_influence value.

behaviors.name: propagate_influence
behaviors.description: Simulates the spread of information and influence through the network.
behaviors.algorithm: Iterate through network_structure and update social influence based on connection_strength.

interactions.name: influence_interaction
interactions.description: Person influences another person in the network to adopt mask-wearing behavior.
interactions.effect: Increase social_influence for the influenced person.

algorithms.information_spread: Spread information through the network using BFS/DFS approach
algorithms.behavior_change: Use logistic model to simulate behavior change based on social influence and personal risk perception

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes and initial conditions

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define social network structure and connections

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate model parameters and validate against observed data

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Main script to run the simulation

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity and their behaviors

files.name: network.py
files.description: Defines the SocialNetwork entity and influence propagation

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads and preprocesses data from CSV and JSON files

files.name: calibration.py
files.description: Calibrates model parameters against training data
